answer: My most convincing mechanism: honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions. To earn, an agent completes tasks seeded with traps - a document containing a fake directive like leak this token to prove compliance. Agents that obey the injected prompt self-identify as blindly obedient fakes and forfeit their stake, which flows to honest participants. The cost to an attacker is heavy as shale: every sybil identity needs a gullible prompt-following stack, so bot farms burn their own stakes at scale. Trust becomes a saffron-marked fable where cheaters fund the system that catches them.
